results.question: How does row level security work?
results.answer: Based on the provided context, Postgres Row Level Security (RLS) gives you granular authorization rules that run inside the database [Source: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security]. Grants and policies combine to control access [Source: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security].

results.question: What is session replay?
results.answer: Session replay records what real users do in your product and plays it back like a DVR, complete with a synced DevTools panel that displays console logs, network requests, and errors at the exact moment they occurred [Source: https://posthog.com/docs/session-replay].
